content:
robin: Heads-up: I'm assembling the release notes and a short migration doc for 0.10.0. Need a couple of snippet fixes and a clear known-issues blurb. Can folks jump in?

maya: On it. What's the migration surface?

robin: Two items: embeddings API switches from streaming to batch, and small behavioral change in dedicated autoscaler backoff that affects time-to-first-token.

jon: I can handle Python SDK snippets. I saw a few examples still using `client.embeddings.stream(...)`. New pattern is `client.embeddings.batch(inputs=[...])` with different return shape.

erin: I'll do link sweep. Found one quickstart link that 404s: /guides/old-quickstart -> should redirect to /getting-started/quickstart. Also the quantization guide link needs updating to the new repo path.

robin: Great. Also need a short known-issues paragraph for Dedicated customers: product wants "intermittent 503s during scale-up" and recommended mitigations (enable burst capacity, configure canary fallback). Keep it concise.

maya: Draft sentence: "Known issue: Dedicated customers may observe intermittent 503s during rapid scale-up events; mitigation: enable burst capacity or configure canary fallback to hosted to maintain availability." Good?

jon: That's fine. Will add a tiny code sample for canary fallback under rollouts.

jon: Example Python config snippet:
```python
# route policy example
route_policy = {
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "policy": "canary",
  "primary": {"deployment": "dedicated-prod"},
  "fallback": {"deployment": "hosted-small", "max_latency_ms": 1000}
}
```

erin: FYI the docs site has a redirect rule: `/snippets/embed-stream` -> `/snippets/embed-batch`. I'll update in-site link targets and add the migration page at /docs/migration/0.10.0/embed-api.

robin: Can we also add a short note on token counting differences after moving to batch embeddings? Customers saw ~1.5x token counts in some cases.

jon: I'll add a bullet: "Token accounting note: batched embeddings include per-input framing tokens; review token estimates when migrating."

maya: Small editorial request: the whats-new section currently says "improved routing intelligence" which reads vague. Suggest: "adaptive routing by cost and latency policy" to be concrete.

robin: Agree, update wording. Also product asked to keep the whats-new short and push details to the full changelog.

docs-bot: Reminder checklist: run snippet-lint, validate redirects, update changelog yaml with PR references.

erin: snippet-lint results: 3 warnings (deprecated embedding methods) and 1 error (broken link). I'll open PR to fix (#4715).

jon: Pushed Python snippet PR #4712, includes migration notes for token counting.

maya: Link fix PR #4715 created, fixes redirects and the quantization guide link.

robin: I drafted the known-issues block and added the canary example under Rollouts. Pushing a single combined PR after the snippet/link PRs land.

release-bot: Auto-generated changelog draft: https://git.redwood-inference/release/0.10.0/changelog-draft.md

robin: Plan: merge snippet & link PRs, then my combined PR with release notes and migration page. Target: ship initial whats-new by tomorrow morning and full changelog by EOD.

erin: Merged #4715, link fixes live on staging.

jon: #4712 merged with Python examples and token note.

docs-bot: All checks green. Remember to add a short migration anchor at the top of the batch-embeddings page for discoverability.

robin: Done, added anchor and published draft migration page. Scheduling release notes publish window now.

release-bot: Scheduled publish: 2026-03-25 08:00 PT.

robin: Thanks team. If anything else pops up, drop it here and I'll patch before final publish. :rocket:
